paragraphs.en: TL;DR: The DuckDB team is happy to announce that today we're releasing DuckDB version 2.0.0 LTS, codenamed “Cinnamon Teal” (Spatula cyanoptera). This is our biggest feature release so far, and it ships a polished version of the Quack protocol, asynchronous I/O, a first-class VARIANT type, agent mode, triggers, an extensible SQL parser and much more, built from close to 20,000 commits since DuckDB 1.5.
paragraphs.zh: 简讯：DuckDB 团队很高兴地宣布，今天我们正式发布 DuckDB 2.0.0 LTS 版本，代号「桂红鸭」（Cinnamon Teal，学名 Spatula cyanoptera）。 这是迄今为止我们规模最大的一次功能发布，包含打磨成熟的 Quack 协议、异步 I/O、一流的 VARIANT 类型、智能体模式、触发器、可扩展的 SQL 解析器等众多特性，汇聚了自 DuckDB 1.5 以来近 20,000 次提交的成果。

sents.en: TL;DR: The DuckDB team is happy to announce that today we're releasing DuckDB version 2.0.0 LTS, codenamed “Cinnamon Teal” (Spatula cyanoptera).
sents.zh: 简讯：DuckDB 团队很高兴地宣布，今天我们正式发布 DuckDB 2.0.0 LTS 版本，代号「桂红鸭」（Cinnamon Teal，学名 Spatula cyanoptera）。

sents.en: This is our biggest feature release so far, and it ships a polished version of the Quack protocol, asynchronous I/O, a first-class VARIANT type, agent mode, triggers, an extensible SQL parser and much more, built from close to 20,000 commits since DuckDB 1.5.
sents.zh: 这是迄今为止我们规模最大的一次功能发布，包含打磨成熟的 Quack 协议、异步 I/O、一流的 VARIANT 类型、智能体模式、触发器、可扩展的 SQL 解析器等众多特性，汇聚了自 DuckDB 1.5 以来近 20,000 次提交的成果。

paragraphs.en: We are proud to release DuckDB 2.0.0, codenamed “Cinnamon Teal” after the Spatula cyanoptera , a strikingly reddish-brown duck found in the western Americas.
paragraphs.zh: 我们很自豪地发布 DuckDB 2.0.0，代号“桂红鸭”，得名于 Spatula cyanoptera（桂红鸭），一种分布于美洲西部的、呈醒目红棕色的鸭子。

paragraphs.en: While DuckDB 1.0 was all about stability and backward compatibility, DuckDB 2.0 is above all a feature release. In this blog post, we summarize the highlights and then walk through the breaking changes and how to migrate. We showcased many of the new features in “A Preview of DuckDB v2.0” , which covers each one in more depth. For the complete release notes, see the release page on GitHub .
paragraphs.zh: 如果说 DuckDB 1.0 的主题是稳定性和向后兼容性，那么 DuckDB 2.0 首要而言是一个功能版本。 在这篇博文中，我们总结其中的亮点，然后逐一介绍破坏性变更以及如何迁移。 我们在《A Preview of DuckDB v2.0》一文中展示了许多新特性，该文对每个特性都进行了更深入的介绍。 完整的发布说明请参见 GitHub 上的发布页面。

sents.en: While DuckDB 1.0 was all about stability and backward compatibility, DuckDB 2.0 is above all a feature release.
sents.zh: 如果说 DuckDB 1.0 的主题是稳定性和向后兼容性，那么 DuckDB 2.0 首要而言是一个功能版本。

sents.en: In this blog post, we summarize the highlights and then walk through the breaking changes and how to migrate.
sents.zh: 在这篇博文中，我们总结其中的亮点，然后逐一介绍破坏性变更以及如何迁移。

sents.en: We showcased many of the new features in “A Preview of DuckDB v2.0” , which covers each one in more depth.
sents.zh: 我们在《A Preview of DuckDB v2.0》一文中展示了许多新特性，该文对每个特性都进行了更深入的介绍。

sents.en: For the complete release notes, see the release page on GitHub .
sents.zh: 完整的发布说明请参见 GitHub 上的发布页面。

paragraphs.en: Tip To install the new version, please visit the installation page .
paragraphs.zh: 提示 要安装新版本，请访问安装页面。

paragraphs.en: With this release, there are currently three DuckDB lines available. DuckDB 2.0 is a long-term support (LTS) release with support until at least October 2027. The previous LTS release, version 1.4, is still supported until November 17, 2026. To ensure a smooth transition and allow sufficient time for testing, we extended the support period of DuckDB 1.5 until March 2027, effectively also turning it into an LTS release. For details, see the release calendar .
paragraphs.zh: 在此版本发布后，目前有三条 DuckDB 版本线可用。 DuckDB 2.0 是一个长期支持（LTS）版本，支持期至少持续到 2027 年 10 月。 之前的 LTS 版本 1.4 仍将受到支持，直至 2026 年 11 月 17 日。 为确保平稳过渡并留出充足的测试时间，我们将 DuckDB 1.5 的支持期延长至 2027 年 3 月，这实际上也使其成为一个 LTS 版本。 有关详细信息，请参阅发布日历。

sents.en: With this release, there are currently three DuckDB lines available.
sents.zh: 在此版本发布后，目前有三条 DuckDB 版本线可用。

sents.en: DuckDB 2.0 is a long-term support (LTS) release with support until at least October 2027.
sents.zh: DuckDB 2.0 是一个长期支持（LTS）版本，支持期至少持续到 2027 年 10 月。

sents.en: The previous LTS release, version 1.4, is still supported until November 17, 2026.
sents.zh: 之前的 LTS 版本 1.4 仍将受到支持，直至 2026 年 11 月 17 日。

sents.en: To ensure a smooth transition and allow sufficient time for testing, we extended the support period of DuckDB 1.5 until March 2027, effectively also turning it into an LTS release.

sents.en: For details, see the release calendar .
sents.zh: 有关详细信息，请参阅发布日历。

paragraphs.en: To find your way around the documentation for all of the new features, we also published a “What's New in the Docs for 2.0” page that links each feature below to its documentation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了帮助您熟悉所有新功能的文档，我们还发布了一个“2.0 文档新特性”页面，将下面的每个功能链接到其相应的文档。

paragraphs.en: DuckDB has been an in-process database since day one. In DuckDB 1.5.3 , released in May, we introduced the Quack protocol that lets you run DuckDB in a traditional client-server setup, along with the quack extension , which implements DuckDB's native protocol, so any DuckDB process can serve its databases .
paragraphs.zh: DuckDB 从诞生之日起就是一个进程内数据库。 在今年 5 月发布的 DuckDB 1.5.3 中，我们引入了 Quack 协议，让你可以在传统的客户端-服务器架构中运行 DuckDB，同时还发布了实现 DuckDB 原生协议的 quack 扩展，从而使任何 DuckDB 进程都能对外提供其数据库服务。

sents.en: DuckDB has been an in-process database since day one.
sents.zh: DuckDB 从诞生之日起就是一个进程内数据库。

sents.en: In DuckDB 1.5.3 , released in May, we introduced the Quack protocol that lets you run DuckDB in a traditional client-server setup, along with the quack extension , which implements DuckDB's native protocol, so any DuckDB process can serve its databases .
sents.zh: 在今年 5 月发布的 DuckDB 1.5.3 中，我们引入了 Quack 协议，让你可以在传统的客户端-服务器架构中运行 DuckDB，同时还发布了实现 DuckDB 原生协议的 quack 扩展，从而使任何 DuckDB 进程都能对外提供其数据库服务。

paragraphs.en: DuckDB 2.0.0 ships a polished version of the Quack protocol with substantial performance and stability improvements. It also introduces the new CONNECT statement that allows attaching and switching to a remote database in a single command for better ergonomics:
paragraphs.zh: DuckDB 2.0.0 发布了打磨完善的 Quack 协议版本，性能和稳定性均有大幅提升。 它还引入了新的 CONNECT 语句，可通过单条命令连接并切换到远程数据库，提供更好的易用性：

sents.en: DuckDB 2.0.0 ships a polished version of the Quack protocol with substantial performance and stability improvements.
sents.zh: DuckDB 2.0.0 发布了打磨完善的 Quack 协议版本，性能和稳定性均有大幅提升。

sents.en: It also introduces the new CONNECT statement that allows attaching and switching to a remote database in a single command for better ergonomics:
sents.zh: 它还引入了新的 CONNECT 语句，可通过单条命令连接并切换到远程数据库，提供更好的易用性：

paragraphs.en: CALL quack_serve ( token = 'my_token' ); CREATE TABLE events ( date DATE , name VARCHAR ); INSERT INTO events VALUES ( '2027-04-07' , 'DuckCon #8' ); quack: DuckDB client ATTACH 'quack:localhost' AS qk ( TOKEN 'my_token' ); CONNECT qk ; SELECT * FROM events ; ┌────────────┬────────────┐ │ date │ name │ │ date │ varchar │ ├────────────┼────────────┤ │ 2027-04-07 │ DuckCon # 8 │ └────────────┴────────────┘ For simplicity, this example runs the server and the client on the same machine. By default, the server only listens on localhost . To accept connections from other machines, keep the server on localhost and put it behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy . The allow_other_hostname option , which exposes the server directly, is only meant for testing.
paragraphs.zh: CALL quack_serve ( token = 'my_token' ); CREATE TABLE events ( date DATE , name VARCHAR ); INSERT INTO events VALUES ( '2027-04-07' , 'DuckCon #8' ); quack: DuckDB 客户端 ATTACH 'quack:localhost' AS qk ( TOKEN 'my_token' ); CONNECT qk ; SELECT * FROM events ; ┌────────────┬────────────┐ │ date │ name │ │ date │ varchar │ ├────────────┼────────────┤ │ 2027-04-07 │ DuckCon # 8 │ └────────────┴────────────┘ 为简单起见，本示例在同一台机器上运行服务器和客户端。 默认情况下，服务器只监听 localhost。 要接受来自其他机器的连接，请将服务器保持在 localhost 上，并将其置于一个 TLS 终止的反向代理之后。 allow_other_hostname 选项会将服务器直接暴露出去，仅用于测试。

sents.en: CALL quack_serve ( token = 'my_token' ); CREATE TABLE events ( date DATE , name VARCHAR ); INSERT INTO events VALUES ( '2027-04-07' , 'DuckCon #8' ); quack: DuckDB client ATTACH 'quack:localhost' AS qk ( TOKEN 'my_token' ); CONNECT qk ; SELECT * FROM events ; ┌────────────┬────────────┐ │ date │ name │ │ date │ varchar │ ├────────────┼────────────┤ │ 2027-04-07 │ DuckCon # 8 │ └────────────┴────────────┘ For simplicity, this example runs the server and the client on the same machine.
sents.zh: CALL quack_serve ( token = 'my_token' ); CREATE TABLE events ( date DATE , name VARCHAR ); INSERT INTO events VALUES ( '2027-04-07' , 'DuckCon #8' ); quack: DuckDB 客户端 ATTACH 'quack:localhost' AS qk ( TOKEN 'my_token' ); CONNECT qk ; SELECT * FROM events ; ┌────────────┬────────────┐ │ date │ name │ │ date │ varchar │ ├────────────┼────────────┤ │ 2027-04-07 │ DuckCon # 8 │ └────────────┴────────────┘ 为简单起见，本示例在同一台机器上运行服务器和客户端。

sents.en: By default, the server only listens on localhost .
sents.zh: 默认情况下，服务器只监听 localhost。

sents.en: To accept connections from other machines, keep the server on localhost and put it behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy .
sents.zh: 要接受来自其他机器的连接，请将服务器保持在 localhost 上，并将其置于一个 TLS 终止的反向代理之后。

sents.en: The allow_other_hostname option , which exposes the server directly, is only meant for testing.
sents.zh: allow_other_hostname 选项会将服务器直接暴露出去，仅用于测试。

paragraphs.en: The CONNECT statement is not limited to Quack: it points your session at any remote database that supports it , including PostgreSQL and MySQL. For these, the new remote pushdown optimizer ships queries directly to the remote server instead of pulling tables over the wire.
paragraphs.zh: CONNECT 语句不仅限于 Quack：它可以将你的会话指向任何支持该语句的远程数据库，包括 PostgreSQL 和 MySQL。 针对这些情况，新的远程下推优化器会将查询直接发送到远程服务器，而不是通过网络拉取整张表。

sents.en: The CONNECT statement is not limited to Quack: it points your session at any remote database that supports it , including PostgreSQL and MySQL.
sents.zh: CONNECT 语句不仅限于 Quack：它可以将你的会话指向任何支持该语句的远程数据库，包括 PostgreSQL 和 MySQL。

sents.en: For these, the new remote pushdown optimizer ships queries directly to the remote server instead of pulling tables over the wire.
sents.zh: 针对这些情况，新的远程下推优化器会将查询直接发送到远程服务器，而不是通过网络拉取整张表。

paragraphs.en: The CLI also has shortcuts for setting up a Quack client-server pair: the new -serve and -connect arguments start a Quack server or connect to one directly from the command line:
paragraphs.zh: CLI 还提供了一些快捷方式，用于设置 Quack 客户端-服务器对：新增的 -serve 和 -connect 参数可以直接从命令行启动 Quack 服务器或连接到服务器：

paragraphs.en: duckdb -serve CREATE TABLE t AS SELECT 42 AS x ; quack: CLI client duckdb -connect FROM t ; ┌───────┐ │ x │ │ int32 │ ├───────┤ │ 42 │ └───────┘ Performance Asynchronous I/O DuckDB 2.0 introduces asynchronous I/O for reading Parquet and CSV files, as well as DuckDB's native storage format . The I/O layer now scales independently from the query processing layer, issuing reads in the background and keeping multiple requests in flight. This means far more parallelism for remote reads and dramatically faster queries on object storage such as s3:// .
paragraphs.zh: duckdb -serve CREATE TABLE t AS SELECT 42 AS x ; quack: CLI 客户端 duckdb -connect FROM t ; ┌───────┐ │ x │ │ int32 │ ├───────┤ │ 42 │ └───────┘ 性能 异步 I/O DuckDB 2.0 为读取 Parquet 和 CSV 文件以及 DuckDB 的原生存储格式引入了异步 I/O。 I/O 层现在可以独立于查询处理层进行扩展，在后台发出读取请求，并让多个请求同时在途处理。 这意味着远程读取可以获得远超以往的并行度，在 s3:// 这类对象存储上的查询速度也将大幅提升。

sents.en: duckdb -serve CREATE TABLE t AS SELECT 42 AS x ; quack: CLI client duckdb -connect FROM t ; ┌───────┐ │ x │ │ int32 │ ├───────┤ │ 42 │ └───────┘ Performance Asynchronous I/O DuckDB 2.0 introduces asynchronous I/O for reading Parquet and CSV files, as well as DuckDB's native storage format .
sents.zh: duckdb -serve CREATE TABLE t AS SELECT 42 AS x ; quack: CLI 客户端 duckdb -connect FROM t ; ┌───────┐ │ x │ │ int32 │ ├───────┤ │ 42 │ └───────┘ 性能 异步 I/O DuckDB 2.0 为读取 Parquet 和 CSV 文件以及 DuckDB 的原生存储格式引入了异步 I/O。

sents.en: The I/O layer now scales independently from the query processing layer, issuing reads in the background and keeping multiple requests in flight.
sents.zh: I/O 层现在可以独立于查询处理层进行扩展，在后台发出读取请求，并让多个请求同时在途处理。

sents.en: This means far more parallelism for remote reads and dramatically faster queries on object storage such as s3:// .
sents.zh: 这意味着远程读取可以获得远超以往的并行度，在 s3:// 这类对象存储上的查询速度也将大幅提升。

paragraphs.en: We described the design in detail in a dedicated blog post . In that post, we showed the network throughput over the course of a query with and without asynchronous I/O:
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一篇专门的博客文章中详细描述了该设计。 在那篇文章中，我们展示了在使用与不使用异步 I/O 的情况下，一次查询过程中的网络吞吐量：

sents.en: We described the design in detail in a dedicated blog post .
sents.zh: 我们在一篇专门的博客文章中详细描述了该设计。

sents.en: In that post, we showed the network throughput over the course of a query with and without asynchronous I/O:
sents.zh: 在那篇文章中，我们展示了在使用与不使用异步 I/O 的情况下，一次查询过程中的网络吞吐量：

paragraphs.en: Network throughput. Higher utilization and shorter runtime are better.
paragraphs.zh: 网络吞吐量。 利用率越高、运行时间越短越好。

sents.en: Network throughput.
sents.zh: 网络吞吐量。

sents.en: Higher utilization and shorter runtime are better.
sents.zh: 利用率越高、运行时间越短越好。

paragraphs.en: The VARIANT type stores semi-structured, schema-less data such as JSON while keeping the performance of columnar execution. So you can think of it as JSON on steroids: a VARIANT column can store differently shaped data in every row, but unlike JSON it is not a text format.
paragraphs.zh: VARIANT 类型用于存储半结构化、无模式的数据（例如 JSON），同时保持列式执行的性能。 因此你可以把它想象成增强版 JSON：VARIANT 列的每一行都可以存储不同结构的数据，但与 JSON 不同的是，它不是一种文本格式。

sents.en: The VARIANT type stores semi-structured, schema-less data such as JSON while keeping the performance of columnar execution.
sents.zh: VARIANT 类型用于存储半结构化、无模式的数据（例如 JSON），同时保持列式执行的性能。

sents.en: So you can think of it as JSON on steroids: a VARIANT column can store differently shaped data in every row, but unlike JSON it is not a text format.
sents.zh: 因此你可以把它想象成增强版 JSON：VARIANT 列的每一行都可以存储不同结构的数据，但与 JSON 不同的是，它不是一种文本格式。

paragraphs.en: DuckDB 1.5 already introduced VARIANT , but DuckDB 2.0 fully integrates it. DuckDB 2.0 detects the common structure in your data and “shreds” it, so it compresses well and executes fast. The pipeline works end to end, from shredded execution straight out of storage to shredded VARIANT reading and writing for Parquet, backed by a family of variant_* functions . For example:
paragraphs.zh: DuckDB 1.5 已经引入了 VARIANT，而 DuckDB 2.0 则将其完全集成。 DuckDB 2.0 会检测数据中的共同结构并对其进行「切分」（shred），从而实现良好的压缩效果和快速的执行速度。 这条流水线可以端到端地工作，从直接基于存储的切分执行，到针对 Parquet 的切分 VARIANT 读写，背后由一系列 variant_* 函数提供支持。例如：

sents.en: DuckDB 1.5 already introduced VARIANT , but DuckDB 2.0 fully integrates it.
sents.zh: DuckDB 1.5 已经引入了 VARIANT，而 DuckDB 2.0 则将其完全集成。

sents.en: DuckDB 2.0 detects the common structure in your data and “shreds” it, so it compresses well and executes fast.
sents.zh: DuckDB 2.0 会检测数据中的共同结构并对其进行「切分」（shred），从而实现良好的压缩效果和快速的执行速度。

sents.en: The pipeline works end to end, from shredded execution straight out of storage to shredded VARIANT reading and writing for Parquet, backed by a family of variant_* functions . For example:
sents.zh: 这条流水线可以端到端地工作，从直接基于存储的切分执行，到针对 Parquet 的切分 VARIANT 读写，背后由一系列 variant_* 函数提供支持。例如：

paragraphs.en: CREATE TABLE events ( payload VARIANT ); INSERT INTO events VALUES ( '{"user": {"id": 42, "tags": ["a", "b"]}}' :: JSON :: VARIANT ), ( '{"event": "click", "x": 10, "y": 20}' :: JSON :: VARIANT ); SELECT variant_type ( payload ), variant_keys ( payload ) FROM events ; ┌───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┐ │ variant_type(payload) │ variant_keys(payload) │ │ varchar │ varchar[] │ ├───────────────────────┼───────────────────────┤ │ OBJECT │ [user] │ │ OBJECT │ [event, x, y] │ └───────────────────────┴───────────────────────┘ Agent Mode in the CLI Coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor increasingly drive the DuckDB CLI on their users' behalf. The 2.0 CLI detects when it is being run by an agent and switches to agent mode : it prints compact Markdown tables instead of padded boxes, says clearly when a result was truncated, stops runaway queries early and reports errors as JSON.
paragraphs.zh: CREATE TABLE events ( payload VARIANT ); INSERT INTO events VALUES ( '{"user": {"id": 42, "tags": ["a", "b"]}}' :: JSON :: VARIANT ), ( '{"event": "click", "x": 10, "y": 20}' :: JSON :: VARIANT ); SELECT variant_type ( payload ), variant_keys ( payload ) FROM events ; ┌───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┐ │ variant_type(payload) │ variant_keys(payload) │ │ varchar │ varchar[] │ ├───────────────────────┼───────────────────────┤ │ OBJECT │ [user] │ │ OBJECT │ [event, x, y] │ └───────────────────────┴───────────────────────┘ CLI 中的智能体模式 Claude Code、Codex 和 Cursor 等编程智能体越来越多地代替用户驱动 DuckDB CLI。 2.0 版 CLI 能够检测到自己正在被智能体运行，并切换到智能体模式：它打印紧凑的 Markdown 表格而非带填充边框的表格，在结果被截断时明确说明，及早停止失控的查询，并将错误以 JSON 形式报告。

sents.en: CREATE TABLE events ( payload VARIANT ); INSERT INTO events VALUES ( '{"user": {"id": 42, "tags": ["a", "b"]}}' :: JSON :: VARIANT ), ( '{"event": "click", "x": 10, "y": 20}' :: JSON :: VARIANT ); SELECT variant_type ( payload ), variant_keys ( payload ) FROM events ; ┌───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┐ │ variant_type(payload) │ variant_keys(payload) │ │ varchar │ varchar[] │ ├───────────────────────┼───────────────────────┤ │ OBJECT │ [user] │ │ OBJECT │ [event, x, y] │ └───────────────────────┴───────────────────────┘ Agent Mode in the CLI Coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor increasingly drive the DuckDB CLI on their users' behalf.
sents.zh: CREATE TABLE events ( payload VARIANT ); INSERT INTO events VALUES ( '{"user": {"id": 42, "tags": ["a", "b"]}}' :: JSON :: VARIANT ), ( '{"event": "click", "x": 10, "y": 20}' :: JSON :: VARIANT ); SELECT variant_type ( payload ), variant_keys ( payload ) FROM events ; ┌───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┐ │ variant_type(payload) │ variant_keys(payload) │ │ varchar │ varchar[] │ ├───────────────────────┼───────────────────────┤ │ OBJECT │ [user] │ │ OBJECT │ [event, x, y] │ └───────────────────────┴───────────────────────┘ CLI 中的智能体模式 Claude Code、Codex 和 Cursor 等编程智能体越来越多地代替用户驱动 DuckDB CLI。

sents.en: The 2.0 CLI detects when it is being run by an agent and switches to agent mode : it prints compact Markdown tables instead of padded boxes, says clearly when a result was truncated, stops runaway queries early and reports errors as JSON.
sents.zh: 2.0 版 CLI 能够检测到自己正在被智能体运行，并切换到智能体模式：它打印紧凑的 Markdown 表格而非带填充边框的表格，在结果被截断时明确说明，及早停止失控的查询，并将错误以 JSON 形式报告。

paragraphs.en: Long-running SQL queries report their expected cost prior to running, so the agent can decide whether to wait. In our experiments on TPC-H, agent mode cut the amount of DuckDB output the model had to read by 59%. You can turn it on for manual testing using the -agent flag or instruct your agent to turn it off using the -no-agent flag.
paragraphs.zh: 长时间运行的 SQL 查询会在执行前报告其预期成本，因此智能体可以决定是否等待。 在我们对 TPC-H 的实验中，智能体模式将模型必须读取的 DuckDB 输出量减少了 59%。 你可以使用 -agent 标志为手动测试开启该功能，或指示你的智能体使用 -no-agent 标志将其关闭。

sents.en: Long-running SQL queries report their expected cost prior to running, so the agent can decide whether to wait.
sents.zh: 长时间运行的 SQL 查询会在执行前报告其预期成本，因此智能体可以决定是否等待。

paragraphs.en: DuckDB has always used a parser derived from PostgreSQL's. In 2.0, our own modern, extensible PEG-based parser , which debuted as an opt-in feature in DuckDB 1.5 , becomes the default. Extensions can now hook into the grammar itself (an idea we first explored in our research on runtime-extensible parsers ), so expect extensions that expose entirely new SQL syntax. Error messages now come with precise source locations. For details, see the PEG parser documentation . The new parser is designed to be compatible with the old one, apart from a few deliberate changes listed in the migration guide . If you notice any other differences, please file an issue. In the meantime, you can switch back to the old parser using the legacy_parser extension by running SET enable_legacy_parser = true ; .
paragraphs.zh: DuckDB 一直使用源自 PostgreSQL 的解析器。 在 2.0 中，我们自己的现代、可扩展的基于 PEG 的解析器——它在 DuckDB 1.5 中作为可选功能首次亮相——成为默认选项。 扩展现在可以挂接到语法本身（这一想法我们在关于运行时可扩展解析器的研究中首次探讨过），因此可以期待暴露全新 SQL 语法的扩展。 错误消息现在带有精确的源代码位置。 详见 PEG 解析器文档。 新解析器的设计与旧解析器兼容，除了迁移指南中列出的少数有意做出的更改。 如果您注意到其他任何差异，请提交 issue。 在此期间，您可以通过运行 SET enable_legacy_parser = true; 来使用 legacy_parser 扩展切换回旧解析器。

paragraphs.en: The old parser had served DuckDB since its first commit in 2018. Its grammar was generated with YACC/Bison, which produces an LALR(1) parser, so as DuckSQL grew, even small additions could collide with existing rules and raise shift/reduce or reduce/reduce conflicts. A PEG grammar avoids this by trying alternatives in the order they are written, so adding syntax no longer risks breaking unrelated rules. Python itself moved to a PEG-based parser in version 3.9 for the same flexibility.
paragraphs.zh: 旧解析器自 2018 年 DuckDB 的首次提交以来一直为其服务。 它的语法是用 YACC/Bison 生成的，后者生成 LALR(1) 解析器，因此随着 DuckSQL 的增长，即使是很小的新增内容也可能与现有规则冲突，并引发移进/归约或归约/归约冲突。 PEG 语法通过按书写的顺序尝试各个备选项来避免这一问题，因此新增语法不再有破坏无关规则的风险。 Python 本身出于同样的灵活性考虑，在 3.9 版本中迁移到了基于 PEG 的解析器。

paragraphs.en: DuckDB 2.0 ships a revamped C API v2 , which is considerably more powerful than its predecessor and exposes components such as file systems and table functions to extensions. Before marking it as stable, we would like to test it in the field, so please give it a try and send us your feedback !
paragraphs.zh: DuckDB 2.0 发布了全面改版的 C API v2，它比前代强大得多，并向扩展暴露了文件系统和表函数等组件。 在将其标记为稳定版之前，我们希望在实际环境中进行测试，所以请试用并向我们发送您的反馈！

sents.en: DuckDB 2.0 ships a revamped C API v2 , which is considerably more powerful than its predecessor and exposes components such as file systems and table functions to extensions.
sents.zh: DuckDB 2.0 发布了全面改版的 C API v2，它比前代强大得多，并向扩展暴露了文件系统和表函数等组件。

sents.en: Before marking it as stable, we would like to test it in the field, so please give it a try and send us your feedback !
sents.zh: 在将其标记为稳定版之前，我们希望在实际环境中进行测试，所以请试用并向我们发送您的反馈！

paragraphs.en: You can also register and host your own trusted extension repositories, so an organization can host and sign its own extensions and have them install and load just like the built-in ones:
paragraphs.zh: 您还可以注册并托管自己的受信任扩展仓库，这样组织就可以托管并签名自己的扩展，使其像内置扩展一样安装和加载：

paragraphs.en: SET allow_extension_repositories = 'allowed' ; CREATE EXTENSION REPOSITORY my_repo WITH PREFIX 'https://extensions.example.org' ; INSTALL AND LOAD my_ext FROM my_repo ; A repository is a name, a URL prefix and one or more RSA public keys that are trusted to sign the extensions served from it. The prefix can point at anything DuckDB can read: a local path, https , s3 , you name it. At CREATE time, DuckDB fetches the repository's public keys and pins them into the repository definition, printing each key's SHA-256 fingerprint so you can compare it against one published out of band.
paragraphs.zh: SET allow_extension_repositories = 'allowed'; CREATE EXTENSION REPOSITORY my_repo WITH PREFIX 'https://extensions.example.org'; INSTALL AND LOAD my_ext FROM my_repo; 仓库是一个名称、一个 URL 前缀，以及一个或多个被信任用于对其所提供的扩展进行签名的 RSA 公钥。 该前缀可以指向 DuckDB 能读取的任何东西：本地路径、https、s3，等等。 在 CREATE 时，DuckDB 会获取该仓库的公钥并将其固定（pin）在仓库定义中，同时打印每个密钥的 SHA-256 指纹，以便你与通过带外渠道发布的指纹进行比对。

sents.en: SET allow_extension_repositories = 'allowed' ; CREATE EXTENSION REPOSITORY my_repo WITH PREFIX 'https://extensions.example.org' ; INSTALL AND LOAD my_ext FROM my_repo ; A repository is a name, a URL prefix and one or more RSA public keys that are trusted to sign the extensions served from it.
sents.zh: SET allow_extension_repositories = 'allowed'; CREATE EXTENSION REPOSITORY my_repo WITH PREFIX 'https://extensions.example.org'; INSTALL AND LOAD my_ext FROM my_repo; 仓库是一个名称、一个 URL 前缀，以及一个或多个被信任用于对其所提供的扩展进行签名的 RSA 公钥。

sents.zh: 该前缀可以指向 DuckDB 能读取的任何东西：本地路径、https、s3，等等。

sents.zh: 在 CREATE 时，DuckDB 会获取该仓库的公钥并将其固定（pin）在仓库定义中，同时打印每个密钥的 SHA-256 指纹，以便你与通过带外渠道发布的指纹进行比对。

paragraphs.en: This feature is still a work in progress and its syntax may change in future releases. For more details, see the Extension Repositories page .
paragraphs.zh: 该功能仍在开发中，其语法可能会在未来的版本中发生变化。 更多详情请参阅「扩展仓库」页面。

paragraphs.en: DuckDB's core extensions are also shipping several new features, fixes and performance optimizations. These are too numerous to all list here, so we only highlight a few of them and will cover them in dedicated blog posts in the coming weeks:
paragraphs.zh: DuckDB 的核心扩展也发布了若干新功能、修复和性能优化。 这些内容太多，无法在此一一列举，因此我们只重点介绍其中几项，并将在未来几周的专门博客文章中详细讲解：

sents.en: DuckDB's core extensions are also shipping several new features, fixes and performance optimizations.
sents.zh: DuckDB 的核心扩展也发布了若干新功能、修复和性能优化。

sents.en: These are too numerous to all list here, so we only highlight a few of them and will cover them in dedicated blog posts in the coming weeks:
sents.zh: 这些内容太多，无法在此一一列举，因此我们只重点介绍其中几项，并将在未来几周的专门博客文章中详细讲解：

paragraphs.en: DuckDB 2.0 delivers triggers: the CREATE TRIGGER statement with BEFORE and AFTER triggers, FOR EACH ROW and FOR EACH STATEMENT , transition tables via REFERENCING OLD/NEW TABLE , multiple triggers per event, RETURNING on triggered tables and DROP TRIGGER . The classic use case is audit tables, where a trigger records what changed in response to a table modification. Some combinations, such as BEFORE ... FOR EACH ROW and UPDATE ... FOR EACH ROW triggers, are not yet supported; see the limitations .
paragraphs.zh: DuckDB 2.0 提供了触发器：包含 BEFORE 和 AFTER 触发器的 CREATE TRIGGER 语句、FOR EACH ROW 和 FOR EACH STATEMENT、通过 REFERENCING OLD/NEW TABLE 实现的过渡表、每个事件可定义多个触发器、对触发器所在表使用 RETURNING，以及 DROP TRIGGER。 经典用例是审计表，触发器在响应表修改时记录发生了哪些更改。 某些组合，例如 BEFORE ... FOR EACH ROW 与 UPDATE ... FOR EACH ROW 触发器，目前尚不支持；参见局限性说明。

sents.en: DuckDB 2.0 delivers triggers: the CREATE TRIGGER statement with BEFORE and AFTER triggers, FOR EACH ROW and FOR EACH STATEMENT , transition tables via REFERENCING OLD/NEW TABLE , multiple triggers per event, RETURNING on triggered tables and DROP TRIGGER .
sents.zh: DuckDB 2.0 提供了触发器：包含 BEFORE 和 AFTER 触发器的 CREATE TRIGGER 语句、FOR EACH ROW 和 FOR EACH STATEMENT、通过 REFERENCING OLD/NEW TABLE 实现的过渡表、每个事件可定义多个触发器、对触发器所在表使用 RETURNING，以及 DROP TRIGGER。

sents.en: The classic use case is audit tables, where a trigger records what changed in response to a table modification.
sents.zh: 经典用例是审计表，触发器在响应表修改时记录发生了哪些更改。

sents.en: Some combinations, such as BEFORE ...
sents.zh: 某些组合，例如 BEFORE ...

sents.en: FOR EACH ROW and UPDATE ...
sents.zh: FOR EACH ROW 与 UPDATE ...

sents.en: FOR EACH ROW triggers, are not yet supported; see the limitations .
sents.zh: FOR EACH ROW 触发器，目前尚不支持；参见局限性说明。

paragraphs.en: CREATE TRIGGER trg_audit AFTER UPDATE ON target REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS o NEW TABLE AS n FOR EACH STATEMENT INSERT INTO audit SELECT n.id , o.val , n.val FROM o JOIN n ON o.id = n.id ; Triggers can also maintain materialized views incrementally! For example, to keep track of the average age of people per nationality in a table age_statistics , you can use two triggers – one for insert and another for delete operations – and store the sum and the count alongside the average.
paragraphs.zh: CREATE TRIGGER trg_audit AFTER UPDATE ON target REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS o NEW TABLE AS n FOR EACH STATEMENT INSERT INTO audit SELECT n.id , o.val , n.val FROM o JOIN n ON o.id = n.id ; 触发器还可以增量维护物化视图！ 例如，为了在表 age_statistics 中按国籍跟踪人员的平均年龄，你可以使用两个触发器——一个用于插入操作，另一个用于删除操作——并在存储平均值的同时存储总和与计数。

sents.en: CREATE TRIGGER trg_audit AFTER UPDATE ON target REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS o NEW TABLE AS n FOR EACH STATEMENT INSERT INTO audit SELECT n.id , o.val , n.val FROM o JOIN n ON o.id = n.id ; Triggers can also maintain materialized views incrementally!
sents.zh: CREATE TRIGGER trg_audit AFTER UPDATE ON target REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS o NEW TABLE AS n FOR EACH STATEMENT INSERT INTO audit SELECT n.id , o.val , n.val FROM o JOIN n ON o.id = n.id ; 触发器还可以增量维护物化视图！

sents.en: For example, to keep track of the average age of people per nationality in a table age_statistics , you can use two triggers – one for insert and another for delete operations – and store the sum and the count alongside the average.
sents.zh: 例如，为了在表 age_statistics 中按国籍跟踪人员的平均年龄，你可以使用两个触发器——一个用于插入操作，另一个用于删除操作——并在存储平均值的同时存储总和与计数。

paragraphs.en: CREATE TABLE people ( name VARCHAR , nationality VARCHAR , age INTEGER ); CREATE TABLE age_statistics ( nationality VARCHAR PRIMARY KEY , sum_age INTEGER , num_people INTEGER , average_age DOUBLE ); On insertion, we aggregate the new rows per nationality and merge them into age_statistics , adding a row for each new nationality:
paragraphs.zh: CREATE TABLE people ( name VARCHAR , nationality VARCHAR , age INTEGER ); CREATE TABLE age_statistics ( nationality VARCHAR PRIMARY KEY , sum_age INTEGER , num_people INTEGER , average_age DOUBLE ); 在插入时，我们按国籍聚合新行，并将其合并到 age_statistics 中，为每个新国籍添加一行：

paragraphs.en: CREATE TRIGGER people_insert AFTER INSERT ON people REFERENCING NEW TABLE AS n FOR EACH STATEMENT MERGE INTO age_statistics s USING ( SELECT nationality , sum ( age ) AS sum_age , count ( * ) AS num_people FROM n GROUP BY nationality ) d ON s.nationality = d.nationality WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET sum_age = s.sum_age + d.sum_age , num_people = s.num_people + d.num_people , average_age = ( s.sum_age + d.sum_age ) / ( s.num_people + d.num_people ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT VALUES ( d.nationality , d.sum_age , d.num_people , d.sum_age / d.num_people ); On deletion, we subtract the deleted rows and drop a nationality once its last person has left:
paragraphs.zh: CREATE TRIGGER people_insert AFTER INSERT ON people REFERENCING NEW TABLE AS n FOR EACH STATEMENT MERGE INTO age_statistics s USING ( SELECT nationality , sum ( age ) AS sum_age , count ( * ) AS num_people FROM n GROUP BY nationality ) d ON s.nationality = d.nationality WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET sum_age = s.sum_age + d.sum_age , num_people = s.num_people + d.num_people , average_age = ( s.sum_age + d.sum_age ) / ( s.num_people + d.num_people ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT VALUES ( d.nationality , d.sum_age , d.num_people , d.sum_age / d.num_people ); 在删除数据时，我们会减去被删除的行，并在某个国籍的最后一个人离开后删除该国籍的记录：

paragraphs.en: CREATE TRIGGER people_delete AFTER DELETE ON people REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS o FOR EACH STATEMENT MERGE INTO age_statistics s USING ( SELECT nationality , sum ( age ) AS sum_age , count ( * ) AS num_people FROM o GROUP BY nationality ) d ON s.nationality = d.nationality WHEN MATCHED AND s.num_people = d.num_people THEN DELETE WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET sum_age = s.sum_age - d.sum_age , num_people = s.num_people - d.num_people , average_age = ( s.sum_age - d.sum_age ) / ( s.num_people - d.num_people ); Let's see people come and go:
paragraphs.zh: CREATE TRIGGER people_delete AFTER DELETE ON people REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS o FOR EACH STATEMENT MERGE INTO age_statistics s USING ( SELECT nationality , sum ( age ) AS sum_age , count ( * ) AS num_people FROM o GROUP BY nationality ) d ON s.nationality = d.nationality WHEN MATCHED AND s.num_people = d.num_people THEN DELETE WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET sum_age = s.sum_age - d.sum_age , num_people = s.num_people - d.num_people , average_age = ( s.sum_age - d.sum_age ) / ( s.num_people - d.num_people ); 让我们看看人员的来来去去：

paragraphs.en: INSERT INTO people VALUES ( 'Alice' , 'US' , 34 ), ( 'Bram' , 'NL' , 27 ), ( 'Csilla' , 'HU' , 45 ), ( 'Dave' , 'US' , 58 ), ( 'Eva' , 'NL' , 19 ), ( 'Femke' , 'NL' , 41 ); FROM age_statistics ORDER BY nationality ; ┌─────────────┬─────────┬────────────┬─────────────┐ │ nationality │ sum_age │ num_people │ average_age │ │ varchar │ int32 │ int32 │ double │ ├─────────────┼─────────┼────────────┼─────────────┤ │ HU │ 45 │ 1 │ 45.0 │ │ NL │ 87 │ 3 │ 29.0 │ │ US │ 92 │ 2 │ 46.0 │ └─────────────┴─────────┴────────────┴─────────────┘ DELETE FROM people WHERE name = 'Alice' ; DELETE FROM people WHERE nationality = 'HU' ; FROM age_statistics ORDER BY nationality ; ┌─────────────┬─────────┬────────────┬─────────────┐ │ nationality │ sum_age │ num_people │ average_age │ │ varchar │ int32 │ int32 │ double │ ├─────────────┼─────────┼────────────┼─────────────┤ │ NL │ 87 │ 3 │ 29.0 │ │ US │ 58 │ 1 │ 58.0 │ └─────────────┴─────────┴────────────┴─────────────┘ Triggers bring us one step closer to materialized views, a long-standing item in the “future work” section of our roadmap .
paragraphs.zh: INSERT INTO people VALUES ( 'Alice' , 'US' , 34 ), ( 'Bram' , 'NL' , 27 ), ( 'Csilla' , 'HU' , 45 ), ( 'Dave' , 'US' , 58 ), ( 'Eva' , 'NL' , 19 ), ( 'Femke' , 'NL' , 41 ); FROM age_statistics ORDER BY nationality ; ┌─────────────┬─────────┬────────────┬─────────────┐ │ nationality │ sum_age │ num_people │ average_age │ │ varchar │ int32 │ int32 │ double │ ├─────────────┼─────────┼────────────┼─────────────┤ │ HU │ 45 │ 1 │ 45.0 │ │ NL │ 87 │ 3 │ 29.0 │ │ US │ 92 │ 2 │ 46.0 │ └─────────────┴─────────┴────────────┴─────────────┘ DELETE FROM people WHERE name = 'Alice' ; DELETE FROM people WHERE nationality = 'HU' ; FROM age_statistics ORDER BY nationality ; ┌─────────────┬─────────┬────────────┬─────────────┐ │ nationality │ sum_age │ num_people │ average_age │ │ varchar │ int32 │ int32 │ double │ ├─────────────┼─────────┼────────────┼─────────────┤ │ NL │ 87 │ 3 │ 29.0 │ │ US │ 58 │ 1 │ 58.0 │ └─────────────┴─────────┴────────────┴─────────────┘ 触发器让我们离物化视图更近了一步，物化视图是我们路线图“未来工作”部分中的一项长期议题。

paragraphs.en: As always, DuckDB's friendly SQL dialect keeps growing. A few favorites from this release cycle:
paragraphs.zh: 一如既往，DuckDB 友好的 SQL 方言在持续发展。 以下是本次发布周期中的一些亮点：

sents.en: As always, DuckDB's friendly SQL dialect keeps growing.
sents.zh: 一如既往，DuckDB 友好的 SQL 方言在持续发展。

sents.en: A few favorites from this release cycle:
sents.zh: 以下是本次发布周期中的一些亮点：

paragraphs.en: There is more: DuckDB 2.0.0 supports the SQL-standard FETCH FIRST and allows UNNEST in the GROUP BY clause . It also ensures well-defined MERGE and UPDATE ... FROM semantics for cases when multiple rows are matched.
paragraphs.zh: 还有更多：DuckDB 2.0.0 支持 SQL 标准的 FETCH FIRST，并允许在 GROUP BY 子句中使用 UNNEST。 它还确保了 MERGE 和 UPDATE ... 具有明确的行为 即在匹配到多行时采用 FROM 语义的情况。

sents.en: There is more: DuckDB 2.0.0 supports the SQL-standard FETCH FIRST and allows UNNEST in the GROUP BY clause .
sents.zh: 还有更多：DuckDB 2.0.0 支持 SQL 标准的 FETCH FIRST，并允许在 GROUP BY 子句中使用 UNNEST。

sents.en: It also ensures well-defined MERGE and UPDATE ...
sents.zh: 它还确保了 MERGE 和 UPDATE ... 具有明确的行为

sents.en: FROM semantics for cases when multiple rows are matched.
sents.zh: 即在匹配到多行时采用 FROM 语义的情况。

paragraphs.en: DuckDB 2.0 comes with a small set of breaking changes. For most users, upgrading is straightforward, but complex deployments running many DuckDB processes need more care. The storage format is the most likely source of problems: DuckDB versions before 2.0 cannot read database files created by DuckDB 2.0. DuckDB 2.0 can still read and write your existing database files, and these remain readable by older versions. We recommend testing 2.0.0 on a shadow system before switching production over. And, if your workload is mission-critical, you may want to wait for the first patch release, coming in November .
paragraphs.zh: DuckDB 2.0 带来了一些不兼容的破坏性变更。 对于大多数用户来说，升级过程很直接，但运行多个 DuckDB 进程的复杂部署则需要更加谨慎。 存储格式是最可能引发问题的来源：DuckDB 2.0 之前的版本无法读取由 DuckDB 2.0 创建的数据库文件。 DuckDB 2.0 仍然可以读写你现有的数据库文件，且这些文件仍可被旧版本读取。 我们建议在将生产环境切换之前，先在影子系统上测试 2.0.0。 此外，如果你的工作负载至关重要，你可能需要等待 11 月发布的第一个补丁版本。

sents.en: DuckDB 2.0 comes with a small set of breaking changes.
sents.zh: DuckDB 2.0 带来了一些不兼容的破坏性变更。

sents.en: For most users, upgrading is straightforward, but complex deployments running many DuckDB processes need more care.
sents.zh: 对于大多数用户来说，升级过程很直接，但运行多个 DuckDB 进程的复杂部署则需要更加谨慎。

sents.en: The storage format is the most likely source of problems: DuckDB versions before 2.0 cannot read database files created by DuckDB 2.0.
sents.zh: 存储格式是最可能引发问题的来源：DuckDB 2.0 之前的版本无法读取由 DuckDB 2.0 创建的数据库文件。

sents.en: DuckDB 2.0 can still read and write your existing database files, and these remain readable by older versions.
sents.zh: DuckDB 2.0 仍然可以读写你现有的数据库文件，且这些文件仍可被旧版本读取。

sents.en: We recommend testing 2.0.0 on a shadow system before switching production over.
sents.zh: 我们建议在将生产环境切换之前，先在影子系统上测试 2.0.0。

sents.en: And, if your workload is mission-critical, you may want to wait for the first patch release, coming in November .
sents.zh: 此外，如果你的工作负载至关重要，你可能需要等待 11 月发布的第一个补丁版本。

paragraphs.en: For the full details, see the migration guide .
paragraphs.zh: 完整详情请参阅迁移指南。

paragraphs.en: Following DuckDB's long stint on C++11, DuckDB 2.0 now requires a C++17 compiler .
paragraphs.zh: 在长期使用 C++11 之后，DuckDB 2.0 现在需要 C++17 编译器。

paragraphs.en: We also switched to Clang as the default compiler for our release builds. On Linux and macOS, both DuckDB and its core extensions are built with Clang. On Windows, the CLI is built with Clang, while most core extensions are still built with MSVC. We may move more Windows builds to Clang in the future, but this requires further changes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还将发布版本的默认编译器切换为 Clang。 在 Linux 和 macOS 上，DuckDB 及其核心扩展均使用 Clang 构建。 在 Windows 上，CLI 使用 Clang 构建，而大多数核心扩展仍使用 MSVC 构建。 未来我们可能会将更多 Windows 构建迁移到 Clang，但这需要进一步的改动。

sents.en: We also switched to Clang as the default compiler for our release builds.
sents.zh: 我们还将发布版本的默认编译器切换为 Clang。

sents.en: On Linux and macOS, both DuckDB and its core extensions are built with Clang.
sents.zh: 在 Linux 和 macOS 上，DuckDB 及其核心扩展均使用 Clang 构建。

sents.en: On Windows, the CLI is built with Clang, while most core extensions are still built with MSVC.
sents.zh: 在 Windows 上，CLI 使用 Clang 构建，而大多数核心扩展仍使用 MSVC 构建。

sents.en: We may move more Windows builds to Clang in the future, but this requires further changes.
sents.zh: 未来我们可能会将更多 Windows 构建迁移到 Clang，但这需要进一步的改动。

paragraphs.en: Timezone-aware timestamps, calendars and collations have always been powered by the ICU library. In 2.0, the ICU library is gone entirely: the icu extension now implements timezones, calendars and collations itself, with the timezone data built directly from the IANA database and compressed down to around 45 kB.
paragraphs.zh: 支持时区的时间戳、日历和排序规则一直以来都由 ICU 库提供支持。 在 2.0 中，ICU 库被完全移除：icu 扩展现在自行实现了时区、日历和排序规则，时区数据直接由 IANA 数据库构建并压缩至约 45 kB。

sents.en: Timezone-aware timestamps, calendars and collations have always been powered by the ICU library.
sents.zh: 支持时区的时间戳、日历和排序规则一直以来都由 ICU 库提供支持。

sents.en: In 2.0, the ICU library is gone entirely: the icu extension now implements timezones, calendars and collations itself, with the timezone data built directly from the IANA database and compressed down to around 45 kB.
sents.zh: 在 2.0 中，ICU 库被完全移除：icu 扩展现在自行实现了时区、日历和排序规则，时区数据直接由 IANA 数据库构建并压缩至约 45 kB。

paragraphs.en: Everything keeps working exactly as before, and the native implementation is also faster. If you find any issues, please let us know !
paragraphs.zh: 一切都和以前完全一样正常运作，而且原生实现还更快。 如果你发现任何问题，请告诉我们！

sents.en: Everything keeps working exactly as before, and the native implementation is also faster.
sents.zh: 一切都和以前完全一样正常运作，而且原生实现还更快。

sents.en: If you find any issues, please let us know !
sents.zh: 如果你发现任何问题，请告诉我们！

paragraphs.en: The old single-arrow lambda syntax ( x -> x + 1 ) is now disabled by default. Use the Python-style syntax instead:
paragraphs.zh: 旧的单箭头 lambda 语法（ x -> x + 1 ）现在默认已被禁用。 请改用 Python 风格的语法：

sents.en: The old single-arrow lambda syntax ( x -> x + 1 ) is now disabled by default.
sents.zh: 旧的单箭头 lambda 语法（ x -> x + 1 ）现在默认已被禁用。

sents.en: Use the Python-style syntax instead:
sents.zh: 请改用 Python 风格的语法：

paragraphs.en: SELECT list_transform ([ 1 , 2 , 3 ], lambda x : x + 1 ); You can temporarily re-enable the old syntax with SET lambda_syntax = 'enable_single_arrow' ; . Both the flag and the single-arrow syntax will be removed entirely in v2.1.
paragraphs.zh: SELECT list_transform ([ 1 , 2 , 3 ], lambda x : x + 1 ); 你可以通过执行 SET lambda_syntax = 'enable_single_arrow' ; 暂时重新启用旧语法。 该开关和单箭头语法将在 v2.1 中被完全移除。

sents.en: SELECT list_transform ([ 1 , 2 , 3 ], lambda x : x + 1 ); You can temporarily re-enable the old syntax with SET lambda_syntax = 'enable_single_arrow' ; .
sents.zh: SELECT list_transform ([ 1 , 2 , 3 ], lambda x : x + 1 ); 你可以通过执行 SET lambda_syntax = 'enable_single_arrow' ; 暂时重新启用旧语法。

sents.en: Both the flag and the single-arrow syntax will be removed entirely in v2.1.
sents.zh: 该开关和单箭头语法将在 v2.1 中被完全移除。

paragraphs.en: The amalgamation build , which bundles DuckDB's entire source code into a single header and a single source file, is now deprecated. The amalgamation has grown too large to be realistically useful in most cases.
paragraphs.zh: 合并构建（amalgamation build）会将 DuckDB 的全部源代码打包到单个头文件和单个源文件中，现已被弃用。 合并文件已经变得过于庞大，在大多数情况下实际上不再有用。

sents.en: The amalgamation build , which bundles DuckDB's entire source code into a single header and a single source file, is now deprecated.
sents.zh: 合并构建（amalgamation build）会将 DuckDB 的全部源代码打包到单个头文件和单个源文件中，现已被弃用。

sents.en: The amalgamation has grown too large to be realistically useful in most cases.
sents.zh: 合并文件已经变得过于庞大，在大多数情况下实际上不再有用。

paragraphs.en: We are gradually phasing out osx_amd64 from the list of fully supported platforms . For the time being, DuckDB and core extensions are still built and supported, but community extensions are no longer built for this platform. DuckDB 2.1 will stop supporting osx_amd64 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们正在逐步将 osx_amd64 从完全支持的平台列表中淘汰。 目前，DuckDB 和核心扩展仍在构建和支持之列，但社区扩展已不再为该平台构建。 DuckDB 2.1 将停止支持 osx_amd64。

sents.en: We are gradually phasing out osx_amd64 from the list of fully supported platforms .
sents.zh: 我们正在逐步将 osx_amd64 从完全支持的平台列表中淘汰。

sents.en: For the time being, DuckDB and core extensions are still built and supported, but community extensions are no longer built for this platform.
sents.zh: 目前，DuckDB 和核心扩展仍在构建和支持之列，但社区扩展已不再为该平台构建。

sents.en: DuckDB 2.1 will stop supporting osx_amd64 .
sents.zh: DuckDB 2.1 将停止支持 osx_amd64。

paragraphs.en: These were a few highlights, but there are many more features and improvements in this release. There have been almost 20,000 commits by many contributors since DuckDB 1.5, shipping smaller features as well as performance and usability improvements. The full release notes can be found on GitHub .
paragraphs.zh: 以上只是部分亮点，本版本还包含许多其他功能和改进。 自 DuckDB 1.5 以来，众多贡献者提交了近 20,000 次代码提交，带来了许多较小的功能以及性能和易用性方面的改进。 完整的发行说明可在 GitHub 上查看。

sents.en: These were a few highlights, but there are many more features and improvements in this release.
sents.zh: 以上只是部分亮点，本版本还包含许多其他功能和改进。

sents.en: There have been almost 20,000 commits by many contributors since DuckDB 1.5, shipping smaller features as well as performance and usability improvements.
sents.zh: 自 DuckDB 1.5 以来，众多贡献者提交了近 20,000 次代码提交，带来了许多较小的功能以及性能和易用性方面的改进。

sents.en: The full release notes can be found on GitHub .
sents.zh: 完整的发行说明可在 GitHub 上查看。

paragraphs.en: We would like to thank our community for the detailed issue reports and feedback that have driven this release, and our special thanks go to our contributors!
paragraphs.zh: 我们要感谢社区提供推动本次发布的详细问题报告和反馈，特别感谢我们的贡献者！
